mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservations (study_room_id, member_id, reserver_name, start_at, end_at, status) VALUES (#{studyRoomId}, #{memberId}, #{reserverName}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{status});
mapper.select: SELECT r.reservation_id, r.study_room_id, s.name AS study_room_name, r.reserver_name, r.start_at, r.end_at, r.status FROM reservations r JOIN study_rooms s ON s.study_room_id = r.study_room_id WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY r.start_at DESC, r.reservation_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
